## **Summary**

Seven standard test methods are used to evaluate antioxidative performance of lubricant additives: **ASTM D2272 (RBOT)**, **ASTM D6186 (PDSC OIT)**, **ASTM E2009 (DSC OOT)**, **ASTM D4742 (TFOUT)**, **ASTM D5483 (PDSC OIT, grease variant)**, **ASTM D2274** (oxidation characteristics), and **GOST 18136 / GOST 3006**. ## **Details**

### 1. Standard Test Methods

| Method | Standard | Principle | Conditions | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **RBOT** | ASTM D2272 | Rotating pressure vessel, O₂ atmosphere, 150–160 °C, Cu catalyst | 150 °C, O₂ at ~620 kPa, rotating | Oxidation induction time (min) |
| **PDSC** | ASTM D6186 | Pressure DSC, isothermal or ramped | 130–180 °C (isothermal), O₂ at 3.5 MPa | Oxidation induction time (OIT, min) |
| **DSC-OOT** | ASTM E2009 | DSC, linear temperature ramp | 10 °C/min, air/O₂ flow | Onset oxidation temperature (°C) |
| **TFOUT** | ASTM D4742 | Thin-film oxygen uptake | 160 °C, metal catalysts (Fe, Cu, Pb) | Induction period (min) |
| **PDSC (grease)** | ASTM D5483 | Pressure DSC for greases | 50 °C/min ramp to 500 °C | OIT (min) |
| **Oxidation characteristics** | ASTM D2274 | Static bomb oxidation | 95 °C, air, 312 h | Volatile acids, insolubles, viscosity increase |
| **ГОСТ** | GOST 18136 | Oxidation stability, temperature ramp | Air flow, 120–200 °C | Induction period, acidic products |
| **ГОСТ** | GOST 3006 (ОТБ-2) | Rotary bomb oxidation test | Analogous to RBOT | Induction period (min) |

### 2. Typical Numerical Values for Phenol-Amine Antioxidants

*(Approximate — require verification from primary literature)*

| **Group I** | Solvent-refined, S-rich | 150N, 500N — most common for screening (most demanding) |
| **Group II** | Hydrotreated, lower S | Chevron 100R, Soltex |

| **Group IV** | PAO | PAO-6, PAO-8 — clean baseline |
